items.where: whole curved Overtoom front above the showroom: five storeys of recessed loggias in a light concrete grid, 1.72 m sub-bays with a thicker pier every third, floor slabs at about 3.06 m pitch, red-framed windows at the back of each loggia
items.how: autoponFront(): one chord per 1.72 m sub-bay on the R 166.45 m arc; radial fins (thick every third), floor slab edges, loggia back wall 1.85 m behind with red-framed glazing

items.where: every loggia storey: a 0.9 m concrete balustrade with close vertical slats (alternate storeys run as continuous bands)
items.how: concrete balustrade panel per sub-bay with four dark vertical slits on its face

items.where: showroom level: tapered wedge pilotis, about 0.7 m at the foot widening to about 2.6 m where they flare into the slab soffit at about 8 m, on a pitch of about 9.2 m
items.how: piloti(): extruded tapered profile with a flared head, eight on the arc 3.85 m behind the slab front

items.where: double-height showroom glazing set back under the slab: lower tier of shop glass and doors, a dark transom band with lamps, upper glass tier
items.how: showroom(): two glass tiers with mullions every 1.7 m and a dark transom band, 4.65 m behind the slab front

items.where: the deep slab soffit over the showroom colonnade, slab edge with the lowest balustrade band at about 8-9.4 m
items.how: soffit slab 8.0-8.6 m spanning to the front face

items.where: north-east end of the front: a flush block with red-framed ribbon/curtain glazing over a stone-clad ground-floor wall
items.how: headBlock(): red frame grid over glass on the 4.3 m end of the arc, stone-clad base to 8.3 m

items.where: ground floor of the north-east head: light square stone panels from pavement to the slab
